twitch.command.description: Runs when someone types a chat command such as !hello. You choose the command word, who may use it, and how often it can run.

fields.command: The word viewers type, with its ! in front. Example: "!hello". Capital letters do not matter unless you tick Case sensitive.
fields.match: Starts with: also runs when extra words follow, like "!so bob" (the extra words become %input%). Exact: only runs when the message is just the command.
fields.permission: Who may use it. Each choice also lets everyone above it in: Subscriber also allows VIPs, moderators and you. Everyone means anybody in chat.
fields.globalCooldown: Seconds to wait before anyone can run this command again. 0 means no waiting. Example: 30.
fields.userCooldown: Seconds each person must wait before they can run it again. 0 means no waiting. Other people can still use it.
fields.caseSensitive: Tick to make "!Hello" and "!hello" count as different commands. Leave unticked to ignore capital letters.

variables.command: The command that was typed, like !hello
variables.input: Everything typed after the command, like "bob hi"
variables.input0: The first word after the command (input1 is the second, and so on)
variables.inputCount: How many words were typed after the command
variables.user: The display name of the person who typed it
variables.userId: Their Twitch user number
variables.isModerator: True if they are a moderator
variables.isSubscriber: True if they are a subscriber
variables.isVip: True if they are a VIP
variables.messageId: The message's id, useful to reply to it

twitch.chatMessage.description: Runs when someone writes a message in your Twitch chat. Use it to react to words, or to log or read out messages.

fields.contains: Only run when the message contains this text, in any capital or small letters. Example: "hello". Leave empty to run for every message.
fields.ignoreBot: Tick to skip messages written by your bot account, so your bot cannot trigger itself.
fields.ignoreSharedChat: Tick to skip messages that come from another channel during a shared chat. Leave unticked to run for those too.

variables.message: The text of the chat message
variables.user: The display name of the person who wrote it
variables.userId: Their Twitch user number
variables.isModerator: True if they are a moderator
variables.isVip: True if they are a VIP
variables.isSubscriber: True if they are a subscriber
variables.bits: Bits cheered with the message (0 if none)
variables.isReply: True if the message replies to another one
variables.emoteCount: How many emotes are in the message
variables.isSharedChat: True if it came from another channel in a shared chat
